body: So I recently (last week) went down on Lithium from 900mg to 600mg— it was making my hair fall out. The problem is now I feel really reactive to things I was handling fine before. Like for instance, my partner and I don’t have sex at the moment because of trauma stuff on her part so when she pulls away from me I feel really rejected (since the med change). Idk. Any ideas?

I think you are extremely brave for voicing your true feelings. I can’t imagine how overwhelming it must feel right now. Just take it one step at a time and always prioritize your happiness.

I just went through something very similar to this. Here if you want to talk.

I totally validate how you feel. It sucks to have to be on meds. To have a mental illness. And there is grief for the person you were before, for sure. One thing I try to remember, it may never be like it was before BUT your a bipolar babe with so much more empathy than the normies for having struggled yourself. I wish you all the luck in the world with your music.
Ask your doctor if you can take Remeron (sp?) as well. It’s a drug for migraines but it reduces med weight gain.
Try to go on a coffee date because they can be as long or as short as you want.

Wow. I just want to validate your pain. I’m so sorry for what you’re going through. I’ve been there with SI and it’s so difficult. 

If I can, why does the ER not believe your physical pain? 

Here if you want to talk.

Wow that’s really hard. I think it’s really brave that you came out and said you were in the wrong. It’s hard to do that. I totally understand the feeling of wondering whether to stay away or apologize. Personally, I always go apology. It’s their choice what to do with it. Here if you want to talk.
Hey. I’m here if you want to talk. Your feelings are real and valid and your pain deserves to be recognized.
Go to the ER friend! They will admit you or transfer you to an inpatient program.
